# Check if Steve Stricker has the best score among all players from the United States
# First, filter players from the United States
us_players = df[df['country'] == 'united states']

# Extract numeric score from the 'score' column (assuming format like "70 + 69 = 139")
# We'll take the last part after "=" and convert to integer
us_players['numeric_score'] = us_players['score'].str.split('=').str[-1].str.strip().astype(int)

# Find the minimum numeric score (best score) among US players
best_score_us = us_players['numeric_score'].min()

# Get Steve Stricker's numeric score
stricker_score = us_players[us_players['player'] == 'steve stricker']['numeric_score'].iloc[0]

# Check if Steve Stricker's score equals the best score among US players
answer = (stricker_score == best_score_us)
